_meta.description: OpenConnector source rows registered by Shillinq for external CBS submissions. Each source row references a CBS endpoint; the actual HTTP call is openconnector's per ADR-019. Shillinq references sources by slug from x-openregister-aggregations outputChannel declarations and x-openregister-scheduled-workflows. No app-local HTTP client to CBS.

cbs-iv3.name: CBS IV3 (base quarterly)
cbs-iv3.description: OpenConnector source for the base CBS IV3 quarterly submission (Informatie voor Derden). Used by the Iv3Export quarterly-cbs-submission workflow and the Iv3Export lifecycle submit transition. No Shillinq-side HTTP client per REQ-CBSE-006 + ADR-019.

cbs-iv3-detail.name: CBS IV3-detail (quarterly)
cbs-iv3-detail.description: OpenConnector source for the CBS Iv3-detail bestand submission (per-taakveld-per-categorie detail). Used by the quarterly-cbs-iv3-detail-submission scheduled workflow on kernGegevensConfig. No Shillinq-side HTTP client per REQ-CBSE-006 + ADR-019.

cbs-kerngegevens.name: CBS Kerngegevens jaarstaten (annual)
cbs-kerngegevens.description: OpenConnector source for the CBS Kerngegevens jaarstaten XML submission. Used by the annual-cbs-kerngegevens-submission scheduled workflow on kernGegevensConfig, triggered annually after jaarrekening-close. No Shillinq-side HTTP client per REQ-CBSE-006 + ADR-019.

cbs-iv3-ozb.name: CBS IV3-OZB (periodic)
cbs-iv3-ozb.description: OpenConnector source for the CBS Iv3-OZB bestand CSV submission (OZB-inkomsten per heffingstijdvak). Used by the quarterly-cbs-iv3-ozb-submission scheduled workflow on kernGegevensConfig. No Shillinq-side HTTP client per REQ-CBSE-006 + ADR-019.

cbs-emu-bestand.name: CBS EMU-bestand (quarterly + annual)
cbs-emu-bestand.description: OpenConnector source for the CBS EMU-bestand XML submission (EMU-saldo and EMU-schuld). Used by the annual-cbs-emu-bestand-submission scheduled workflow on kernGegevensConfig. Consumes ESA-2010 classifier from sibling bookkeeping-emu-reporting. No Shillinq-side HTTP client per REQ-CBSE-006 + ADR-019.
